scope: Pipeline review and concrete implementation defects; decision about stage3 versus macro engine work. No new physiological tuning or new numerical method.

decision_alternatives.A: Small stage3 diagnostic with unchanged mechanisms; only if engine selection and interpretation are explicit. No long campaign at present speed.
decision_alternatives.B: Continue engine architecture on measured global nonlinear/event dependency cost; establish one falsifier before coding another numerical method.
decision_alternatives.C: Alternative general execution architecture; require actual operator and coupling coverage, cost model and common control rather than synthetic-only speed.

checks: Legacy runner engine selection, interruption/outcome receipts, snapshot validity/operator completeness, numerical verifier coverage, publication freezing. Preserve original sources and historical contract. Reproduce failures before correction; real smoke only, not stage3 admission.
stop: Deliver repaired concrete pipeline, bounded evidence and external recommendation; no restart of cancelled pilot or automatic publication of unrelated files.
